qualification.education_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. (Mechanical / Chemical / Electrical) / MBA in Materials Management / Supply Chain Management / PG Diploma in Materials Management / SCM
qualification.details: B.E./B.Tech. (Mechanical / Chemical / Electrical) MBA in Materials Management Supply Chain Management PG Diploma in Materials Management / SCM Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Global & Strategic Procurement and Import, preferably handling mechanical equipment, engineering spares, critical components and project materials. Proven experience in international sourcing and supplier development, including identification, evaluation, qualification and development of overseas suppliers, and building long-term supplier relationships for competitive pricing, quality, reliability and continuous improvement. Hands-on experience in end-to-end import and inbound logistics, including shipment planning, freight/transport coordination, shipping-line coordination, customs clearance, CHA handling, port operations and delivery of imported materials to plant/project sites. Responsible for procurement of critical and long-lead engineering items from overseas suppliers within approved budgets and timelines, ensuring timely availability for operations, maintenance and project requirements. Strong experience in technical-commercial evaluation, price negotiation and finalization of Purchase Orders, contracts, agreements and commercial terms & conditions. Sound understanding of contractual and commercial risk management, including warranties, guarantees, liquidated damages, force majeure, insurance, claims, penalties, liabilities and other risk-mitigation measures. Thorough knowledge of international procurement and import procedures, including Incoterms, Letter of Credit (LC), advance/open-account payment terms, customs formalities, HS classification, import documentation and applicable customs duty/tax structure. Should have good knowledge of domestic procurement, taxation, statutory requirements and contract management for supply and services, wherever applicable. Coordinate with Finance/Accounts and internal stakeholders for timely processing of supplier payments as per contractual terms and established company procedures. Monitor long-lead, critical items, identify potential procurement, manufacturing, shipping and logistics risks, and take proactive corrective actions to ensure timely delivery. Strong negotiation, analytical, commercial and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop practical solutions and achieve cost optimization without compromising quality, reliability or delivery timelines. Ability to manage multiple procurement priorities and competing requirements, with strong planning, coordination, organizational and time-management skills. Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to effectively coordinate with overseas suppliers, consultants, OEMs, freight forwarders, CHA, shipping lines and cross-functional internal teams. Working knowledge of SAP/SRM is mandatory, particularly for PR/PO processing, procurement transactions, supplier management, order tracking and related Materials Management activities. Should be willing to closely coordinate with Engineering, Maintenance, Projects, Finance, Stores, Logistics and other user departments for timely procurement and receipt of engineering materials. | MBA (Marketing / International Business / Logistics) Candidates should have full time qualification at required level in the respective discipline. He/She should have completed MBA (Marketing / International Business / Logistics) full time from 2024, 2025 and 2026. Candidates having experience in Heavy Chemicals / Fertilizers / Petrochemicals industries will be given preference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GACL recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for GACL recruitment is 27 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for Officer (Purchase)- Import?
faq.answer: For the Officer (Purchase)- Import post, candidates need a B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Chemical, or Electrical engineering, or an MBA in Materials Management/Supply Chain Management, or a PG Diploma in Materials Management/SCM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for Executive Trainee (Marketing)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Executive Trainee (Marketing) position is 30 years. Candidates should ensure they meet this age criterion before applying for the role.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for GACL recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this GACL recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum experience required for Officer (Purchase)- Import?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in Global & Strategic Procurement and Import is required for the Officer (Purchase)- Import position. This experience should cover various aspects of procurement and logistics.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates with experience in other industries apply for Executive Trainee (Marketing)?
faq.answer: While candidates with experience in Heavy Chemicals, Fertilizers, or Petrochemicals industries will be given preference for the Executive Trainee (Marketing) role, the primary qualification is an MBA in Marketing, International Business, or Logistics.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the GACL recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for GACL recruitment must be submitted online through the official GACL website or the direct application link provided. Ensure all details are accurate and documents are uploaded correctly.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these GACL positions?
faq.answer: The job type for the advertised positions is Full Time. This indicates a regular employment opportunity with Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited.

faq.answer: The official GACL recruitment notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, where a direct link to the PDF is provided. It's crucial to read this document thoroughly.
